name: osquery
description: SQL-based operating system instrumentation framework for security monitoring and compliance

osqueryd.description: Background daemon for continuous system monitoring and log collection using SQL queries

osqueryi.description: Interactive shell for ad-hoc system queries and investigation using SQL syntax
osqueryi.usage:
osqueryi
osqueryi --json 'SELECT * FROM processes;'
osqueryi --line 'SELECT name FROM processes;'
osqueryi --config_path=config.conf
osqueryi '.tables'
